snippet.title: STONEFEATHER - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to STONEFEATHER, an atmospheric flying adventure. 

Fly as a stone-born bird across silent ruins, ride updrafts, build momentum, and restore the vanished wind. 

Wishlist STONEFEATHER on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3034760/STONEFEATHER/

After years of work, we are excited to finally share this project with you.

Here you will find trailers, gameplay clips, and development updates.

Follow the project:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stonefeather_ac/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@stonefeather_ac
X: https://x.com/STONEFEATHER_AC
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/stonefeather-ac.bsky.social
